description: Football fixtures, results, form and league tables for the Premier League, Championship, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1, current season (worked out from the date; 2026/27 now). Tables include official points deductions. Understands everyday club names (Spurs, Man Utd, Barca, PSG, Wolves, Nottm Forest, the Toon, Inter Milan), full spoken names and small typos (Liverpol, Nottingham Forrest). Clubs from other leagues that people often ask about (Celtic, Rangers, Ajax, Benfica, Inter Miami) get a 404 that says which league they play in. Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. More at https://formguide.pages.dev
